CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2697 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head d0d35231c633ca447acf04770f9034281417b72d. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch d0d35231c633ca447acf04770f9034281417b72d for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r6, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-merge-subject-harden-r6 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r6; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden (tip 4b12f7385b8b9a0ac9a0c768ccba5ce0adb36df5, code of PR #2697 at head d0d35231c633ca447acf04770f9034281417b72d); do not restart from main. Merge origin/main first.
Round 5 verdict (git show origin/review/2697:VERDICT.md; read it whole): blocked `class-open`. MERGE_CALL reads some spellings of the `pr merge --subject` call but not the whole class: program spellings outside PROGRAM, an interpolated program in ONE string literal, return `[]` from subjectWriters: Python `f"{GH} pr merge {n} --subject x"`, `f"{gh_bin} pr merge ..."`, `subprocess.run(f"{self.gh} pr merge {n} -t x", shell=True)`, `"%s pr merge %s --subject x" % (GH, n)`, `"{} pr merge {} -t x".format(GH, n)`, JS `` `${cfg.gh} pr merge ${n} --subject x` ``. The control `${GH}` form is refused today. This is the round-4 class (2), not a new class.
This is the fifth block of the same class by spelling: close the CLASS, not the six spellings. Replace the per-spelling regex growth with a structural reader (tokenise the string literal or argv, accept any program-position expression that precedes the words `pr merge`, whatever interpolation syntax produced it) or record an explicit, reasoned scope line stating what spellings are out of scope and why (a disposition under Unpinned sites), with a null control. Probe the class with a generator of interpolation shapes (f-string, %, .format, template literal, concatenation, list-join) over program names, not a hand list, and keep the reviewer's own six as fixtures.
Body: this is round 5's successor, so by fixer.md's three-round rule you RE-CUT, you do not repair. Write a MINIMAL body that carries only figures re-taken in this pass (no figure carried from an earlier body, each with its command and result), and close the class structurally as above. If the class cannot be closed structurally, SPLIT the PR: land the seams that are closed (with their controls and mutants) and carry the unclosed remainder to a new roster group (name it in the body's Forward-carry with the verbatim text and say so plainly in `## Head`); do not add a sixth spelling patch.
Push handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r6 (new 40-hex tip) and handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r6.
no host or home paths in anything you push
